segments.contextBefore: To handle updates to the dragon model, the app creates the `updateMaterials(_:)` method, which employs a recursive approach to update all child entities that the parent entity manages.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift import RealityKit extension Entity { public func updateMaterials(_ update: (inout Material) -> Void) { // Call recursive method to all child entities. for child in children { child.updateMaterials(update) } // Apply the new values to the component material. if var comp = components[ModelComponent.self] { comp.materials = comp.materials.map { material in var copy = material update(&copy) return copy } components.set(comp) } } } ```
